# Pankow MCP

> Pankow is an LLM testing and evaluation platform. This file documents the Pankow MCP server — a streamable-HTTP MCP server for managing AI tests, projects, and CI runs programmatically.

MCP endpoint: https://pankow-production.up.railway.app/mcp (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0, MCP revision 2026-07-28).
The server exposes 14 tool definitions (the platform's 10 MCP tools plus get_config/list_runs/get_run) for listing and managing Pankow resources.

## Getting Started
- [Pankow](https://pankow-production.up.railway.app/): The Pankow platform — sign up and manage your AI tests
- [Docs](https://pankow-production.up.railway.app/docs): Pankow documentation
- [Storefront README](https://github.com/Markera-OU/pankow-mcp): Repo with server.json, AGENTS.md, and examples

## MCP Tools
- [Tool reference](https://github.com/Markera-OU/pankow-mcp/blob/main/README.md#tools): list_orgs, list_projects, list_tests, test_history, create_test, create_project, configure_project, update_test, delete_test, get_config, list_runs, get_run, run_tests, run_tests_cli
